name: Die Langläufer
summary: At Bleachmane Rock, Perith Stormhoof is trapped after a peace effort with the gnolls turned violent. Cairne Bloodhoof sent the scout, and his safe return matters to the Tauren people.

sections.title: A Scout in Danger
sections.body: Cairne Bloodhoof sent Perith Stormhoof to meet the gnolls settled here. Perith is one of Cairne’s Long Runners, so he cannot speak of the full mission. The attempt at peace turned violent, and he fears the gnolls will eat him if he stays through the night. You are asked to help him escape Bleachmane Rock and report his safety to Cairne in Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Cairne’s Thanks
sections.body: Cairne is relieved that Perith is safe. He calls the scout his most trusted and says the mission is greatly important. Cairne thanks you for risking your life to save Perith. You have done the Tauren people a greater service than you know.

faq.answer: Perith Stormhoof is one of Cairne Bloodhoof’s Long Runners, the chieftain’s scouts.

faq.q: Why is Perith at Bleachmane Rock?
faq.answer: Cairne sent Perith to meet the gnolls settled there, though Perith cannot discuss the full mission.

faq.q: What happened to the peace effort?
faq.answer: The gnolls answered the Long Runners’ attempt at peace with violence, leaving Perith in danger.

faq.q: What does Cairne ask me to do?
faq.answer: You are asked to help Perith escape Bleachmane Rock and tell Cairne in Thunder Bluff that he is safe.

angles.text: As a Tauren, you are helping Cairne Bloodhoof’s trusted scout. His mission matters to the Tauren people.
